pages.title: Three Places to Rest
pages.text: Plains and sunflower plains: Post House, with cooking and repair stations. Forests, birch forests and flower forests: Herbal Retreat, with crop beds and brewing. Deserts: Caravan Court, with a well and cartography table. Find them with Explorer’s Compass; the first three quest chapters include visits.

pages.title: The Tomb Lies Below
pages.text: New tombs have a surface pavilion and a lit ladder shaft leading down to the buried passage. Do not expect the burial hall on the surface at the compass marker. Existing structures are not rebuilt automatically: these changes require new generation or placement.
